title: Putting It All Together
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Unit synthesis across energy diagrams, gas graphs, particle models, and concentration tables. Use only assigned data/model evidence; no physical lab is required.

directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the gas container model with pressure, volume, temperature, and particle controls. Set a starting condition and record pressure, volume, temperature, and particle amount. Change only one variable at a time while keeping the other variables as constant as the simulation allows. Record before-and-after values and state the gas-law relationship shown by the model.
